params.message:
Describe and check slugs; say that a changed slug forwards

Every slug field gets a short description: 2 to 5 words, lowercase,
hyphens, no articles or dates, the search term in the language of that
version, empty means the Dutch slug applies. Pages, frames and blog
articles add that changing the slug is safe because the old address
forwards (hoet-eyewear document_slugs and journal_slugs).

The slug field accepted anything typed into it; the English slug of the
O1 was a sentence with spaces. Now a slug with anything other than
lowercase letters, digits and hyphens is an error that shows the clean
form, more than five words is a warning, and Generate cleans the way the
site does (accents dropped). Once a published slug is changed, an info
line names the old address that will forward.

The collection document's slug is not used for any address on the site;
its description now points to the collection page, where the address
comes from.

Portal: In de Studio staat bij elke slug hoe hij eruit hoort te zien, en dat wijzigen veilig is omdat het oude adres doorstuurt.
